_comment: Forever Party Rentals — Event Layout Planner starter templates. Premium spacing standard: ~4 ft chair-pull-out / walk aisle between chair backs. Default chair is resin garden (1.67×1.83 ft); banquet tables 6ft are vertical (rotation:90) with chairCount:6 (no end chairs) so head/foot joint overlap doesn't occur. Multi-tent layouts (100+ guests) use two or three smaller marquees adjacent — matches real-world event setups since the largest single catalog tent is 30×60. Coordinates cx/cy are item centers in feet. Tables marked withChairs:true get auto-chair placement applied at load time via planner.js placeChairsAround(). chairCount on a table overrides the catalog default (used to limit chairs to long-sides-only for end-to-end runs or vertical stacking).
